_about: Public-domain Samuel Cox (1826-1893), Baptist minister of Nottingham and founding editor of The Expositor, for the Word Hoard: The Private Letters of St. Paul and St. John (1867), The Quest of the Chief Good (1868), Expository Essays and Discourses (1877), Salvator Mundi (1878), An Expositor's Note-book (1879), The Genesis of Evil (1880), A Commentary on the Book of Job (1880) and Miracles: an Argument and a Challenge (1884), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 58 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
